# Cornerstone AI: we build your business its operating system

Every business has an operating system: the way work actually moves through it. How a client gets onboarded, how projects get tracked, how invoices go out, how nothing slips. Most businesses never designed theirs. It grew by accident, and the founder became it.

I build the real one. A system built around how your business already works, run by AI, sitting across the tools you already use, and owned outright by you. It reads and writes in your email, your client list, your invoicing and your project board, so your team keeps working where they work and sees one shared picture instead of five half-updated tools.

One rule is built in from day one: routine work runs on its own, but anything leaving the business, money or a message to a client, waits for a human yes.

Delivered as an eight-week build, followed by four more weeks of support at no charge. It is sold as deployed capacity rather than a fixed scope: you buy eight weeks of building aimed at whatever the business actually needs, decided as you go. Week one maps how work moves. Weeks two to eight build it live, one thing at a time, with two training sessions for the team. Anything sent is answered inside 24 hours and anything already built is fixed inside 24 hours. Anything new is live within seven days of being started. Up to five requests sit in the queue at once and are worked one at a time. $6,000 USD, paid up front. Three new businesses a month, which is the whole capacity.

Everything is built inside your own accounts, so your data never moves into mine and the system keeps running whether or not I am involved. There is no platform fee and no licence. After the twelve weeks there are two optional continuity options, billed per four-week cycle: Keep building at $2,000, or Support at $500. Neither renews on its own and neither is required.

Built for businesses with real clients and a small team, where everything still routes through the founder and that is capping growth.

Based in South Africa. Serving businesses globally.
